stackedworld.customize.title: Sky Islands
stackedworld.customize.land_frequency.to: Higher puts more islands over forests, plains, and other land. Lower leaves more open sky above that land. Default is %s%%.
stackedworld.customize.land_size.tooltip: Higher makes the islands over land wider. Lower makes them smaller. Default is %s%%.
stackedworld.customize.ocean_frequency.t: Higher puts more islands over oceans, lakes, and rivers. Lower leaves more open sky above that water. Default is %s%%.
stackedworld.customize.ocean_size.toolti: Higher makes the islands over water wider. Lower makes them smaller. Default is %s%%.
